'''Anagrams''' in Star Wars CCG are character (and a few other) titles that scramble the names of Decipher staff, Lucasfilm contacts, squadron members, pets, and movie in-jokes. They have no effect on play. Hidden-image eggs are on [[Easter eggs]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

A fan page collected the list while Decipher employees were still adding them; two unnamed Decipher people confirmed Premiere still hid names and that the public list was incomplete.<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians] at oocities.org (GeoCities mirror)</ref><ref name="geo2">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians] at geocities.ws</ref><ref name="reo">[https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians] at reocities.com (archive, 6 April 2016)</ref>
